title: Exact zero inertia is not a regular limit, and no closed cycle gains momentum

statements.text: A physical inertial eigenvalue can approach zero only by driving the Legendre map toward degeneracy, so exact zero inertia is not a regular limit. Any apparent reduction of inertia is paid for by the temporal field and the actuator, and an isolated closed cycle cannot generate net four-momentum.

standing.reason: The obstruction is graded exact by the author, and the retained engineering program is graded open. No experiment has tested it.
